title: Nau GitHub repo paid software ki jagah
content:
Nau GitHub repos.
Hazaron dollar ke paid software ki jagah le sakte hain.

Pehla, OpenHigsfield.
Higgsfield ki jagah.

Doosra, Voice Studio.
ElevenLabs ki jagah.
Seedhe tumhari machine pe chalta hai.

Teesra, OpenSEO.
SEMrush ki jagah.
Rank tracking, backlinks, aur site audit.
Sab ek jagah.

Chautha, AppFlowy.
Notion ki jagah.
Local models ke saath kaam karta hai.

Paanchva, OpenWhisper.
WhisperFlow ki jagah.
Kisi bhi app mein bol kar likhwa sakte ho.
Online ya offline.

Chhatha, OpenProject.
Asana ki jagah.

Saatva, Cal.com.
Calendly ki jagah.
Google aur Outlook ke saath sync.

Aathva, Chatwoot.
Intercom ki jagah.
Har lead aur client ka message, ek inbox mein.

Nauva, Cap.
Loom ki jagah.

Comment karo, repo.
Main saare links muft bhej dunga.
